column1: # The roots `voxel_package::ingest` is allowed to walk: `label <TAB> kind <TAB> path`.
# **Declared, not discovered.** A survey that picks its own roots is a survey that silently misses a
# drive, and one that walks a whole volume cannot run at all — `F:` answered a naive `find` in 400
# seconds in the session that wrote this file. So the corpus is named here, in one place, where a
# reader can see what is in scope and what is not.
# **Kinds, and what each one is for.** `this-tree` is this workspace, measured the same way as
# anything else so the lineage comparison has a side to compare against. `sibling` is the same
# project at another time — the material for "how did a downstream change differ from an upstream
# one". `upstream` is a tree this one learned from, read as reasons and never as requirements.
# `corpus` is foreign source vendored as material. `other` is a project with its own decisions.
# **Every root here was measured before it was declared** (see PATCH-039), and a root that is absent
# is reported absent rather than as a zero.
# What this file is NOT: an import list. Nothing here is consumed by being named — `ingest` reads
# names and first pages, writes nothing, and a record only ever lands by a patch that says so.
